title: Feynman AI
tagline: An AI examiner that grades how well you actually understand what you studied
problem: The Feynman technique works by explaining a concept out loud in your own words, but self-study tools grade recall (quizzes, flashcards), not whether an explanation is actually grounded in the source material or has real gaps.
solution: Built a real-time speaking-session app: ingest resources (text, URL, PDF/DOCX/PPTX/TXT, OCR'd images), chunk and embed them into Qdrant, then stream live transcription over WebSocket while the user explains a topic out loud. A strict "examiner, not tutor" LLM prompt runs rolling analysis every 20-30 seconds, asks probing questions grounded in retrieved context, and never just gives the answer. Ends in a mastery report with a confidence score, missed concepts, and per-session/aggregate analytics.
